messages:
marina: OK team — we have a new 7B candidate (gptx-7b-v2) coming through. Need a quick decision on which eval suites to prioritize for onboarding and the exact pass/fail gate definitions. I want a short checklist we can run in the harness this week.
aj: agree. Can we split by risk: regressions against prod prompts, hallucination-sensitive tasks, and latency/cost checks for quantized variants?
kevin_w: +1. For regressions we should use the last 3 deploy-critical prompt-sets (prod_core, customer_support, search_ranking). Stat test: require p-value > 0.05 AND delta <= 1.5% for top-1 metric, otherwise fail.
sara_ml: note on sample sizes: each prompt-set should have min 1k evals or fallback to aggregated bootstrap if smaller. For hallucination-sensitive, run truthfulness suite and require F1 >= baseline - 2 pts.
marina: good. For quantized 4-bit run, we also gate on LM-perplexity + end-to-end latency. Latency SLO: 99th perc < 220ms on c6i-like hosts (sim). Cost: token cost estimate <= 0.9x baseline.
kevin_w: also add an operational rollback criterion: if canary errors spike > 2x baseline (5m rolling), auto-hold. Mentioned in runbook.
aj: Draft checklist (short):
- confirm model artifacts + checksums
- run harness: prod_core, customer_support, search_ranking (1k each)
- run truthfulness suite (aligned with eval-truth-v3)
- run latency/cost bench for quant variants
- regression stats and per-prompt breakdown
- canary deploy to 5% with error monitoring
- slo hold if any gate fails

sara_ml: putting the harness command here:
```
./run_eval_harness --model gptx-7b-v2 --suites prod_core,customer_support,search_ranking,eval-truth-v3 --samples 1000 --quant 4bit --store results/2468001234
```
Include --bootstrap on small sets.
marina: who can run the first pass today? I can kick off infra, need someone to own analysis.
kevin_w: I can own analysis and thresholds. Will post a quick notebook for per-prompt deltas.
aj: I'll start the quant latency run and produce a token-cost estimate.
eval-bot: test-run queued: job 2468001234-1, suites queued: prod_core,customer_support,search_ranking; expected ~45m.
marina: awesome — please flag any early regressions in this thread. If we hit a single hard-fail (stat/regression/latency) we pause onboarding and schedule quick triage. :thumbsup:
